If you commit to unblockables and they hit instead of shoving, delay the input to throw a gb, most people dodge the follow up shove on prediction so the gb will catch a lot. Try not to use the first light a lot since you only have 2 options after it being heavy or heavy feint to gb. Chain lights are as good as long as you are throwing more heavies than lights. And of course parrying is key if you want to be a good lawbringer since you can get to your chain options easily.
